namespaces.historical_seed_policy: Separate string namespace and hashed entropy; no direct reuse of historical numerical evaluation seeds. No reserved_test generation before verified approval and registration.

validation_plan.tuning: All 12 validation_tune corpora, r=.5, sigma=1, symmetric only, four queries/item, 30 vector rules; no field selection.
validation_plan.checking: All 12 independent validation_check corpora, every r/sigma/mode, three principal layouts plus content shuffle and association permutation. Primary canvas translation and 512/spacing12 descriptive study. No layout tuning.
validation_plan.precision: SD of paired primary corpus effects / sqrt(50); approximate simultaneous halfwidth 2.394 * SE. Planning diagnostic only. Keep proposed n=50 unless reviewed before registration.

vector_selection.criterion: Maximize mean sibling_precision_at_5 among rules whose mean exact_top1 >= RAW_SIGNED_NN mean minus .01; raw lambda=0 guarantees a feasible rule.
vector_selection.ties: Within 1e-12 sibling mean: smaller lambda, then smaller k, then raw before processed.
vector_selection.weights: Top k other items by signed stored-vector cosine, stable insertion tie order; positive cosines normalized to sum one; empty neighborhood falls back to own signed score.

decision.placement_achieved: Weighted overlapping signed similarity improves over RANDOM_MATCHED by >1e-6 on every primary corpus. Family enrichment and actual-offset pattern agreement are measured separately.

costs.measurement: Primary symmetric queries, all snapshots return five indices and scores; rotated arm order; cached and uncached field variants; uncompressed NPZ plus JSON serialization measured independently of retained Python state.

registration.failure_policy: Log every attempted corpus failure, preserve all partial outputs, no replacement seeds. A post-exposure correction requires a public amendment and explicit contamination decision before another run.
